thunderRoulette.rule2: A single number pays {base}×. Each spin strikes 1 to 5 lightning numbers: if your number is struck and wins, it pays the lightning multiplier ({min}× to {max}×) instead.
thunderRoulette.rule3: Dozens pay 3×. Red, Black, Even, Odd, 1–18 and 19–36 pay 2×. Zero loses all outside bets.
thunderRoulette.ruleRtp: Theoretical return to player: {rtp}% on single numbers and 97.3% on outside bets (exact).
thunderRoulette.ruleServer: The pocket and the lightning numbers are drawn on the HANNIBAL server before the animation starts.

sbk.liveIntro: Every match being played now. Prices move with the game; tap a match for all markets, the timeline and the statistics.
sbk.liveOff: Live betting is closed right now.
sbk.liveNote: Live bet: it is checked again after {seconds} seconds. If a goal is scored or the market closes, it is cancelled and nothing is taken.
sbk.liveNoteShort: Live prices move with the game. A goal or a closed market cancels a bet before it is accepted.
sbk.closed: Betting on this match is closed right now.
sbk.noMarkets: No prices for this match yet. Come back closer to kick-off.
sbk.noStats: No statistics for this match yet.
sbk.rule90: Every market counts the regular 90 minutes plus added time; extra time and penalty shoot-outs do not count.
sbk.ruleCorners: Corners and cards: each yellow and each red card counts 1. If the match goes to extra time, or the statistics are not available, these bets are void (stake returned).
sbk.ruleNextGoal: Next goal: counted from the score at the moment your bet is accepted.
sbk.ruleLive: Live bets are accepted after a short check. If a goal is scored or the price is suspended during the check, the bet is cancelled.
sbk.ruleVoid: Cancelled or abandoned matches are void: a single bet is refunded; in an accumulator that match counts as 1.00.
sbk.admLiveMax: Highest stake of a live bet (whole units)
sbk.admLiveDelay: Seconds of checking before a live bet is accepted (3–30)
sbk.admLiveHelp: During the check the price and the score are read again: a goal, a suspended market or a lower price cancels the bet. No live bets after the 88th minute.
sbk.admFbLiveNames: Live bets sent by the provider
sbk.admFbPreNames: Pre-match bets sent by the provider
sbk.admFbNoKey: No football API key on the server.

adminGift.title: Daily gift

adminGift.needDeposit: Only players who made at least one deposit
adminGift.range: Check the amounts: smallest at least 0.01, biggest not below the smallest and at most 1000; gifts per day 0 to 100000.
adminGift.note: Every gift is written in the ledger (type: daily gift) and appears in the player's transactions.

reelSlots.payNote: Wins for 3, 4 and 5 symbols on a line ({lines} lines), at your current bet.
reelSlots.ruleMax: Maximum win: {max}× the bet per round (free spins included).
reelSlots.ruleRtp: Theoretical return to player: {rtp}% (simulated over millions of rounds).
reelSlots.ruleServer: Every result is decided on the HANNIBAL server before the reels turn.

chilliheat.title: Chilli Hot Wins
chilliheat.tagline: Turn up the heat. Chase the big win.
chilliheat.ready: Choose your bet and spin to play.
chilliheat.rule1: 5 reels, 3 rows and 20 fixed paylines. Match 3, 4 or 5 symbols on a line from the leftmost reel.
chilliheat.rule2: The 🔥 WILD stands in for every symbol except the 🎺 trumpet.
chilliheat.rule3: 4 or 5 🎺 trumpets anywhere on the reels win 5 free spins at the same bet — no stake is taken. 4 or more in the free spins give 5 more.

ultimatestriker.title: Ultimate Striker
ultimatestriker.tagline: WILD ON THE WAY · FREE SPINS · RISING MULTIPLIERS
ultimatestriker.wildText: Substitutes for regular symbols and pays on its own.
ultimatestriker.risingText: Free spins start at x2. Scatters during free spins add 5 spins and raise the multiplier (up to x10).
ultimatestriker.rulesLine: 10 fixed paylines · Wins are evaluated left to right · Maximum win: {max}× stake.
ultimatestriker.scatterPay: 3 or more anywhere: 5 free spins at x2
ultimatestriker.rule1: 5 reels, 3 rows and 10 fixed paylines, paid left to right.
ultimatestriker.rule2: The ⭐ STRIKER WILD stands in for every symbol except the stadium; 3, 4 or 5 WILDs on a line pay on their own.
ultimatestriker.rule3: 3 or more 🏟️ stadiums anywhere win 5 free spins at the same bet with a x2 multiplier — no stake is taken.
ultimatestriker.rule4: In the free spins, 3 more stadiums give 5 more spins and raise the multiplier by 1 (up to x10); 2 or more WILDs on a free spin double its win.

bigbass.title: Hannibal Big Bass
bigbass.tagline: Catch the fish. Collect the prizes.
bigbass.fsIntroSub: The fisherman collects the cash fish
bigbass.rule1: 5 reels, 3 rows and 20 fixed paylines, paid left to right. The WILD stands in for every symbol except the scatter.
bigbass.rule2: 3, 4 or 5 FREE SPINS scatters anywhere win 10, 15 or 20 free spins at the same bet — no stake is taken.
bigbass.rule3: Every 🐟 cash fish shows its prize on the reels (0.5× to 25× the bet). In the free spins the fisherman is also WILD, and when he lands he collects every cash fish prize.
bigbass.rule4: Fishermen are counted in the free spins: every 4 give +10 free spins and raise the multiplier to x2, then x3, then x10 (on line wins and fish).

adminBuySpins.title: Big Bass — buy spins
adminBuySpins.help: Players can buy a package of spins at their bet. Price of a package = spins × bet, minus the discount.

blackjack.title: HANNIBAL Blackjack
blackjack.rule1: Get closer to 21 than the dealer without going over. Picture cards count 10, an Ace counts 1 or 11.
blackjack.rule2: Blackjack (an Ace and a 10-value card as your first two cards) pays 3 to 2. Other wins pay 1 to 1; a tie gives your bet back.
blackjack.rule3: Hit takes a card, Stand keeps your hand. Double: one more bet and exactly one more card. Split two cards of the same value into two hands (once per hand).
blackjack.rule4: The dealer draws to 17 and stands on all 17s. With an Ace or a 10 showing, the dealer checks for blackjack first.
blackjack.rule5: 6 decks, shuffled again for every hand. A hand you leave stays on the table until you come back.
blackjack.ruleRtp: Return to player with the best play: {rtp}%.
blackjack.ruleServer: Every card is dealt by the server; nothing can be changed from your device.
blackjack.resumed: Your hand is still on the table
